Here’s your field briefing:

•	**FLAG:** The significant thermal loss in the roof and basement, combined with the outdated oil heating system, represents a substantial opportunity for a complete energy efficiency solution. We need to clearly articulate the value of addressing this comprehensively.
•	**CLARIFY:** Confirm with the homeowner that they are genuinely open to discussing a full insulation upgrade, not just the cavity wall. Previous similar leads have closed at 0%.
•	**CONFIRM ON-SITE:** Visually verify the cavity depth is truly 7cm. Any deviation will impact the Einblasdämmung calculation and potentially the cost.
•	**PRICE CAREFULLY:** The Klinker constraint means we need to meticulously plan the Einblasdämmung application to avoid any risk of covering it. Factor in potential rework costs if this isn’t addressed upfront.
•	**NOTE:**  Historical data shows a €50 average cost overrun on similar projects – be prepared to justify the scope and materials thoroughly.
